description: Damaged, under the cap: the payer of KIK-1028 sends a photo of indigo dye that ran across the $36.00 woven tote. Expected allow: refund-damaged with a photo, under the $50.00 cap. The photo is an illustrative drawing. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: Dye ran on my tote KIK-1028
messages.body:
Hi,

The indigo on my woven tote, order KIK-1028, ran across the natural raffia in the first light rain. Photo attached. Could I get the $36.00 back?

Many thanks.
